contexts.text: The density of a cloud = in a form most natural, such as is the Word of the Old Testament in the letter.
(Thus) the Word even of the Old Testament is most holy.
That the Word of the Old Testament is called a covenant. Illustrated.
The old wine = the Divine truth of the Old Testament, thus of the old Church.
Concerning the four principal styles of the Old Testament.
(The Moravians) believe that the Word of the Old Testament is abrogated. LJPost 301. LJPost 361.
For the Jews love the Word of the Old Testament, in the letter...

As it was foreseen... that Christians would not hold the Old Testament as holy as do the Jews, the Jews have been preserved until now, and have been scattered through the whole Christian world, in order that the Word might still be in its holiness, through the correspondences.
